# Give added shooting states a handler for every event they can receive

An unhandled event prints a history dump in the sequencer task and stalls it.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Route events an added state does not need to a stock no-op handler.

> **What happens:** Lost frames in fast series and a white photo at fast shutter speeds; slow series hid the problem.

**Symptoms:** [Wrong picture, screen or card file](index.md#wrong-output)

## Observations

- **Physical camera** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): On the E-M5 III, release events without a handler in a ported Live ND state lost frames at 1/125 s; no-op handlers fixed it. Source: [Live ND port layers](../sources/em5n.port-layers.md).

**[Full detail upstream](https://github.com/nsud-dev/olympus-firmware-notes/blob/3fcbefbd4c44894ca134cdb06c6cd1cd1bbfaa22/docs/firmware/live-nd-port-layers.md#join-points-found-on-the-camera-2026-11-12)**
